note: Raw per-guna bands are on the 1-6 item-average scale (no neutral midpoint, forced-choice). Dominance patterns use each guna's share of the total AFTER subtracting the scale floor (mean - 1, i.e. a 0-5 scale), so the three shares sum to 100 and span the full 0-100 range instead of being compressed toward 33%. Rules are applied in order; the first match wins. Gunas are relative to each other, so the shares drive the pattern and the raw means show absolute intensity.

bands.label: Low clarity
bands.description: Discipline, contentment and mental steadiness aren't strong pulls for you right now; activity or inertia pull on you more than calm focus.

bands.label: Moderate clarity
bands.description: You have some steadiness and discipline alongside other pulls; your clarity comes and goes with circumstance.

bands.label: High clarity
bands.description: You feel a strong pull toward discipline, truthfulness and equanimity, and you're generally composed and content.

bands.label: Low drive-restlessness
bands.description: You're not particularly driven by desire or restless activity; you're comfortable with stillness and with enough.

bands.label: Moderate drive
bands.description: You have some ambition and restlessness, balanced by other tendencies.

bands.label: High drive-restlessness
bands.description: You feel a strong pull toward striving, desire and constant activity, and you're rarely fully satisfied or still.

bands.label: Low inertia
bands.description: You feel little pull toward procrastination, confusion or heaviness; you're generally alert and engaged.

bands.label: Moderate inertia
bands.description: Some heaviness or avoidance shows up for you now and then, alongside more active or clear states.

bands.label: High inertia
bands.description: You feel a strong pull toward confusion, low motivation or resistance to change; getting moving or thinking clearly takes effort.

dominance_patterns.condition: top guna >= 45% AND leads the second by >= 10 points
dominance_patterns.label: {guna}-dominant
dominance_patterns.description: One mode clearly leads and colours most of how you operate day to day.

dominance_patterns.condition: top two gunas each >= 30%, third below 25%
dominance_patterns.label: {guna_a}-{guna_b} blend
dominance_patterns.description: You alternate between two modes depending on context, and the third rarely shows up.

dominance_patterns.label: Balanced / fluid
dominance_patterns.description: No single mode dominates; you likely shift noticeably with circumstances, sleep, stress and company.

dominance_patterns.label: {guna}-leaning
dominance_patterns.description: One mode leads for you, but not strongly enough to call it dominant, and the other two aren't clearly split. Watch for the leading mode; the others still show up regularly.
